mapper.sql: scrum_products.id, scrum_products.product_name, scrum_products.product_code, scrum_products.product_owner_id, scrum_products.scrum_master_id, scrum_products.team_id, scrum_products.product_source, scrum_products.product_status, scrum_products.product_progress, scrum_products.total_man_day, scrum_products.product_value, scrum_products.product_goal, scrum_products.user_story, scrum_products.acceptance_standard, scrum_products.boundary, scrum_products.stakeholders, scrum_products.customers, scrum_products.plan_start_date, scrum_products.plan_end_date, scrum_products.total_work_days, scrum_products.worked_days, scrum_products.product_remarks, scrum_products.is_deleted, scrum_products.create_time, scrum_products.update_time, scrum_products.creator, scrum_products.updater
mapper.select:
SELECT , COALESCE(po.real_name, po.username) AS po_name, COALESCE(sm.real_name, sm.username) AS sm_name, d.dept_name AS team_name, IFNULL(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user u WHERE u.dept_id = scrum_products.team_id AND u.status = 1 ), 0) AS team_member_count FROM scrum_products LEFT JOIN sys_user po ON po.id = scrum_products.product_owner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user sm ON sm.id = scrum_products.scrum_master_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = scrum_products.team_id
scrum_products.is_deleted = 0
AND scrum_products.id = #{queryForm.productId}
ORDER BY scrum_products.create_time DESC
